creator: Alexander Terp
description: A replay carries no images, so after the app reattaches a pane, the surface has none of the pane's kitty images while the daemon's headless terminal still holds them and answers queries about their ids as present. A program that re-places an image by id then draws nothing. Found in the round-2 review of streams (round-2/review-2.md). Store size is 320 MB per screen, Ghostty's default, kept deliberately.
title: Kitty images vanish from the surface after reattach but the daemon still knows them
